title: Foundation ready checkpoint after SKR04, posting groups, VAT and dimensions boundaries
purpose: Classify W1 Foundation after SKR04 starter accounts, posting group prerequisites, parked General Posting Setup route, parked VAT matrix and revalidated Dimensions starter set.

smartDecision.whyNow: The visible W1 Foundation building blocks have either been proven, parked, or blocked. Before master data, the project needs a checkpoint that prevents overclaiming posting readiness.
smartDecision.risk: Moving to master data without a checkpoint could hide parked setup gaps.
smartDecision.fallback: If the checkpoint finds a hard blocker, create the next narrow setup case instead of unlocking master data.

entryCriteria: TARGET-033 result exists and is reviewed.
No setup write, master data, Preview Posting or Posting occurred in TARGET-033.
acceptanceCriteria: Foundation status is classified as ready, ready-with-parked-boundaries, or blocked.
Master Data remains locked unless the checkpoint explicitly unlocks it with boundaries.
No BC or Playwright execution is needed for the checkpoint.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-033 revalidated starter dimensions and parked Global/Default Dimensions.
nextStepDecision.reason: A checkpoint is the safest next step before deciding whether master data can start with known parked boundaries.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The dimensions starter set is visible; checkpoint can classify remaining parked setup gaps.
Master data remains locked until Foundation checkpoint accepts the remaining parked boundaries.
No Preview Posting before master data and posting/VAT boundaries are deliberately accepted.

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: The starter dimensions are visible; the next value is a Foundation checkpoint that states exactly what is proven, parked and still blocked.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not claim Global Dimension Code 1/2 are assigned.
Do not claim Default Dimensions exist for customers, vendors or items.
Do not unlock master data, Preview Posting or Posting without the Foundation checkpoint.
requiredPreparation: Review Page 314 and VAT parked boundaries before checkpoint.
